title: Calibrate WEF Data Policy council term before assigning Hsiao dates
summary: Establish the historical term boundaries of the Global Future Council on Data Policy from dated public records, then use that calibration only as context while searching for a direct Hsiao-specific roster artifact.

selection_reason: The Data Equity interval is directly dated but the earlier Data Policy interval is not; calibrating the council's historical term is the next bounded evidentiary step.

data.target: Global Future Council on Data Policy historical term calibration
data.query: Global Future Council on Data Policy 2020 2021 term members Katherine Hsiao archived WEF roster
data.research_question: What were the dated term boundaries of the Data Policy council, and can a direct public artifact place Hsiao inside that term?
objectives: Recover dated references identifying the Data Policy council term boundaries.
Search archived official WEF member/roster pages for Katherine Hsiao.
Recover the Pathways to Digital Justice contributor/advisory pages when possible.
Keep council-level term evidence separate from person-level membership evidence.
in_scope: Archived copies of official WEF pages
Authoritative institutional biographies used only to calibrate council term labels
out_of_scope: Converting general council dates into Hsiao-specific dates without direct evidence
preferred_sources: Internet Archive copies of official WEF pages
selection_reason: Historical term calibration can narrow the artifact search without inventing person-level chronology.
